svg.text: PreCool Pulse: is the cold air actually cooling the produce? Solution architecture, Phase 2
Solid teal boxes: software that exists and is tested. Grey dashed boxes: proposed hardware, NOT PHYSICALLY BUILT. No value in this project was measured by the team.

What this shows, and what it does not
Shows, in simulation: when the proposed signal reveals a fault and when it is fooled (tarp gaps, mixed return air, missed jets,
warm or cool pallets, sensor drift, a weak fan). Does not show: any detection rate or energy saving in a real precooler. The
simulated readings are not live data.
UCI = air speed × (return air temperature − supply air temperature). It is a relative index, not an energy meter.
